2608.20427.title: BF1: A Causal Dyadic Sparse-Attention Retrofit for Efficient Long-Context Transformers
2608.20427.paper_summary: Dense causal attention remains expensive at long context even when implemented with highly optimized exact kernels. We study BF1, a deterministic block-aligned dyadic sparse-attention route that combines a small exact local neighborhood, a global first block, and logarithmically spaced historical blocks. The route is related to prior log-sparse and dilated attention patterns; our contribution is a correctness-gated pretrained-model retrofit, a matched topology-control study, and a systems characterization that connects per-layer sparsity to whole-model latency. For fixed block width, every converted layer uses O(n log n) selected token interactions and has O(log n) graph communication depth. On an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, an optimized BF16 implementation crosses dense attention between 2K and 4K tokens and reaches a 10.91x per-layer prefill speedup at 32K. Retrofitting eight of 28 Qwen3-0.6B attention layers lowers warm whole-model time to first token by 7.7%, 11.3%, and 15.3% at 8K, 16K, and 32K, respectively, while the remaining dense layers keep the complete model asymptotically quadratic. Under a matched 1,000-step, 16.384M-token adaptation protocol, BF1 ranks first across three training seeds: mean report perplexity is 1.68639 versus 1.69154 for a matched static-random nonlocal graph, 1.69258 for dense continued training, and 1.81505 for equal-budget local sliding. At seed 1234, the packed-report paired interval places Dense-CT 0.3169-0.4055% above BF1 and static-random graph 17 0.2441-0.3642% above BF1. These results establish BF1 as a reproducible sparse operator and selective retrofit primitive with real long-context systems value. This paper evaluates numerical correctness, selected-interaction scaling, kernel performance, partial-model inference, and matched next-token language modeling.
2608.20427.paper_summary_zh: 密集因果注意在長上下文中仍然昂貴，即使在高度優化的精確內核中實現。我們研究BF1，一種確定性的區塊對齊雙邊稀疏注意路徑，該路徑結合了一個小的精確局部鄰域、一個全局第一區塊，以及對數間隔的歷史區塊。該路徑與先前的對數稀疏和擴張注意模式相關；我們的貢獻是一個正確性閘控的預訓練模型改造、一個匹配的拓撲控制研究，以及一個將每層稀疏性與整體模型延遲連接的系統特徵化。對於固定的區塊寬度，每個轉換層使用O(n log n)選定的標記互動，並具有O(log n)圖形通信深度。在NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU上，優化的BF16實現跨越2K到4K標記的密集注意，並在32K時達到每層預填充速度提升10.91倍。對28個Qwen3-0.6B注意層中的八個進行改造，將整體模型的首次標記的預熱時間分別降低了7.7%、11.3%和15.3%（在8K、16K和32K時），而其餘的密集層保持整個模型漸近二次性。在匹配的1,000步、16.384M標記適應協議下，BF1在三個訓練種子中排名第一：平均報告困惑度為1.68639，而匹配的靜態隨機非局部圖為1.69154，密集持續訓練為1.69258，等預算局部滑動為1.81505。在種子1234中，打包報告的配對間隔使得Dense-CT比BF1高出0.3169-0.4055%，靜態隨機圖17比BF1高出0.2441-0.3642%。這些結果確立了BF1作為一個可重現的稀疏運算符和選擇性改造原語，具有實際的長上下文系統價值。本文評估了數值正確性、選定互動的擴展性、內核性能、部分模型推斷及匹配的下一標記語言建模。
